title: Project Engineer
abstract: Site based role working on newly awarded TMR projects. Projects based in Brisbane and Norther QLD.
bullets: TMR Projects valued up to $30M (Brisbane and Northern QLD)
Regular salary reviews, Growing contractor, Long-term projects
content_text:
Project Engineer 
TMR Civil Projects 
$120,000 – $160,000 + Superannuation + Fully Maintained Vehicle 
Site Uplift and LAFHA for regional projects 
Brisbane and Northern QLD 
Established civil contracting business delivering major road and infrastructure projects for the Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR) across Queensland. 
Role 
 This is a great opportunity for a civil engineer with genuine TMR project experience who is looking to build their career on a diverse pipeline of road construction and upgrade works, while being rewarded with a strong salary package and additional site-based incentives.
About You
 - Proven experience delivering TMR / Main Roads projects, ideally across road construction, upgrades, or civil infrastructure works
 - A degree qualification in Civil Engineering (or equivalent trade/technical background with strong TMR project exposure)
 - Strong understanding of TMR specifications, quality systems, and contract delivery requirements
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with clients, subcontractors, and site teams
 - A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple projects
 - A current driver's licence and willingness to travel
 Roster & Flexibility This role requires flexibility to work on regional rosters when required, including 10:4 or 5:2 rotations, to support project delivery in Northern QLD. 
Benefits 
 - Regular salary reviews 
 - Clear routes to project management 
 - Long-term projects locally and regionally 
 - Down-to-earth senior management
How to Apply
 If you would be interested in finding out more information please click "Apply" and forward your updated resume. Alternatively, call our Business Lead, Kyle for a confidential chat on 0482 096 006.
